I don't have a policy covering account deletion, so I can't confirm whether your Plant Club subscription could continue without an account. I'd suggest not deleting anything yet, in case it ends your subscription.

For context, Plant Club is managed under "Account" > "Subscriptions". The next charge is on the 25th (October 25), and cancelling has no fee. An already-billed box is still sent and not refunded.

Would you like me to escalate this to a Support Lead to confirm whether you can do both?
